answer.reason: The verses tell two deeds of Ahimaaz: carrying word to David during Absalom's revolt, and running ahead of Cushi with news of the battle.

clauses.english: carried word to King David of Ahithophel's counsel against him, escaping Absalom's servants
clauses.quote: they went and told king David

clauses.english: ran ahead of Cushi to bring King David news of the battle
clauses.quote: Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

doubts: 2SA 17:18-19, where he hides in the well, and 2SA 17:21 are not marked but give the story of the escape; I cited 2SA 17:21 and 17:20 for it.
